correctness.rationale: For any finite irreducible row Markov generator Q and state i, decompose occupation at i into Exp(a_i) sojourn followed by independent post-departure first-return excursion T_i. Laplace renewal gives R_s[ii]=1/(1+a_i E[s(1-exp(-T_i/s))]); T_i>0, finite mean. Since s(1-exp(-t/s))=int_0^t exp(-u/s)du strictly increases in s>0, R_s[ii] strictly decreases 1->pi_i for all irreducible directed nonreversible chains. R_s is nonnegative row-stochastic as inverse M matrix and C_h=2 R_{h/2}-I, so positivity iff every diagonal >=1/2; therefore unique initial [0,h*] interval with no reentrant positivity. Nonuniform directed n-cycle special case Q=a(P-I), R_s[ii]=1/(1+r+...+r^{n-1}); unique root sum_{j=1}^{n-1}r^j=1 and h*=2r/(a(1-r)), h3=(1+sqrt5)/a, limit 2/a. Independently reconstructed R_s and killed-chain first-return Laplace transforms over exact rational matrices for three genuinely nonreversible CTMCs, 3 s parameters each; all diagonal identities agree. Infinite proof depends on regeneration, not on this finite check.
